_comment: The inputs the placement, leak and e2e gates render with. Acme is not a
real product and never becomes one: this tree is placed into a temp
directory, asserted against, and deleted. The values are chosen to be
AWKWARD rather than tidy — a product name with an apostrophe and an
ampersand (both legal in the card's pattern, both special in TypeScript
strings, HTML and a PR title), a hyphenated repo slug that CONTAINS the
word `pay`, an owner other than the baseline's, and NO domain — a
console build asks for none, so the placeholder <reponame>.example.com
is what a product is born with — because a fixture that only uses values
the templates were written against proves the templates work on the
Every key here is an input repo-blueprint.yaml declares. A key it does not
declare is a fixture that has drifted, and orun refuses it.
